## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …); breaking changes use `!`.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/)).
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, and the repository's test command passes locally.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] Large changes were agreed in an issue first.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, licence keys, IPs, hostnames or player data are included anywhere in this change.
